correctness.rationale: The identities \(M^3=I+2M\) and \(M^6=5I+8M\) were reconstructed directly. Exact first-binomial-term valuation \(3+\nu_2(z-w)\), remainder at least \(5+\nu_2(z-w)\), proves a two-adic isometry. A finite-residue bijection argument supplies existence/uniqueness of the root. All modular cases and coefficient counts have rigorous arguments, with independent exact integer checks.

value.rationale: A finite coefficient test determines which of infinitely many natural recurrence sequences have bounded valuations and which have unique Hensel-type lifting classes at all powers of two. It resolves the explicit unknown coefficient phenomenon noted by the generalized Fibonacci study and gives exact divisibility-index densities. The problem is mathematically motivated beyond mere computation.
